reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001183 (the melody read from 001183a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Arthur Cottman's dates (1842–1879) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Cottman_Arthur (Cottman, Arthur, 1842-1879; its biography says born about November 1841); CCEH's page gives only the year 1872. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001183a.nwc). The tune ends on F, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
